crossRefs.note: When you have stayed three days, go down quickly, and come to the place where you hid yourself when this started, and…
So Amasa went to call the men of Judah together; but he stayed longer than the set time which he had appointed him.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David

translations.web: In the morning, Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little boy with him.
translations.bsb: In the morning Jonathan went out to the field for the appointment with David, and a small boy was with him.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass in the morning, that Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little lad with him.
translations.asv: And it came to pass in the morning, that Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little lad with him.
